check.title: Differentiate a product

check.referenceAnswer: (fg)' = f'g + fg'. It adds the derivative of each factor times the other factor.
check.feedback: The derivative splits into two terms, not one product of derivatives.

check.feedback: The derivative of a product is a sum of two terms, not a product of derivatives.
